topic: What if you could switch off sleep?
part: Chapter 3 of 6: the fun part escalates, the kitchen (long-form, ~45 s)
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD
SWITCH OFF SLEEP?
previous_text: By sunrise, you've done a week of homework, read six books, and you feel… great. No coffee. No yawning. Nothing.

script.text: Morning. Mom finds you at the counter. Dressed. Breakfast made.
She asks if you slept. You say, kind of.
Midnight snacks turn into a second dinner. Pizza at two. Cookies at four.
The cat sleeps most of the day. You sleep none of it. She does not approve.
Your little sister notices too. She's up at six for cartoons, and you're already there. Every single morning.
She asks how. You put a finger to your lips. Secret.

science.claim: A cat sleeps most of the day
science.working: adult house cats sleep about 12-16 hours in 24 (more than half the day)
science.source: Cornell Feline Health Center; general veterinary references (12-16 h a day)

shots.note: Morning: you at the island, dressed, breakfast out, mug steaming; Mom (white, rose robe, bob) walks in from the right and stops
Breakfast made: plate with eggs and toast, a steaming mug, sliding into frame; a READY tag
Mom across the island, worried, leans in: did you sleep? You, smug, shrug: kind of
Midnight: the dark kitchen, you at the island eating, eyes glowing; plates pile up, an open pizza box: SECOND DINNER
Clock 2:00 next to a pizza slice held up, bites taken; clock flips 4:00, a cookie stack shrinks bite by bite
The cat curled asleep on the counter in the sun, breathing; ZZZ; 14 HRS tag
The cat opens one eye (peek) at you, unimpressed
6:00, your little sister (black, teal pajamas, bunches) shuffles in rubbing her eyes
She looks up: you are already at the island, waving with cereal; she freezes, shock
Every morning: MON / TUE / WED tags flip, you in a new pose each time, she in shock each time
Your sister, eyes narrowed, suspicious: how?
You put a finger to your lips, cool, eyes glint: Secret
